issues.title: Dangling Cross-References to External Modules
issues.why: The spec heavily relies on external files (e.g., 13-generic-cli/20-terminal-output-design.md) which are not provided in this context, making it impossible for an AI to verify the 'Terminal Output' or 'Shell Activation' contracts.
issues.fix: Incorporate the normative content of the terminal-output and shell-activation contracts directly into the 16-generic-release module or provide them in the context.

issues.title: Incomplete Concurrency/Race Condition Handling
issues.why: While AC-07 and AC-08 mention immutability and draft-promotion, the provided shell snippets for 'Compress' and 'Checksum' stages lack atomic file operations or cleanup for partial failures in a local environment.
issues.fix: Add 'set -o pipefail' and trap-based cleanup to all shell examples, and explicitly define behavior for 'tag already exists' during the Resolve Version stage.

issues.title: Ambiguous Placeholder Syntax Families
issues.why: The changelog mentions a Phase 123 update for '09-placeholder-tokens.md' with two syntactic families, but the actual file 09 is missing from the provided text, leaving the AI to guess between <NAME> and __NAME__.
issues.fix: Include the content of 09-placeholder-tokens.md to pin the exact regex/string patterns for substitution.
